relay.cli.usage: run a meeting point for multiplayer games over the internet
--per-address <number>         machines one address may connect (default: {default_per_address}, at most {most_per_address})
--rooms-per-address <number>   rooms one address may have open (default: {default_rooms}, at most {most_rooms})
Players behind one shared address (a campus, some mobile networks) may need more of both.
